thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8472 fired in eu-west-1 — embeddings-service 5xx spike detected (alertgroup: embeddings-high-5xx). auto-ack: false. link: https://pd.example/PD-8472 :rotating_light:

Europe-oncall: Acked in PD. I'm on the bridge. Starting triage, looking at request traces and recent deploys.

alex: I'm pulling logs now — 5xx mostly from the embeddings-api -> redis layer. Any recent infra changes?

support-jamie: Support seeing multiple customer error reports (CS-1234, CS-1237). Customers report embedding failures and timeouts. I'll open a status page draft.

maya: Quick checklist — runbook `embeddings-failover` suggests scaling dedicated pool and enabling fallback model. Running scale now:```bash
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-dedicated -n prod --replicas=3
```

ben: If you need, I can take handoff in ~20m. Plan: scale, enable fallback model v0.9-compact, and monitor 5xx%. Also verify redis connectivity. :eyes:

Europe-oncall: Scale applied, new pods spinning up. Also toggled fallback to v0.9-compact (configmap patch). Seeing repeated `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` from redis in logs:```text
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z embeddings-api ERROR redis: dial tcp 10.24.3.5:6379: connect: connection refused
```

sre-lead: Looks like redis in eu-west-1 is flapping. Recommend failing over to replica and restarting primary. @ben can you attempt a graceful restart of redis-primary? We should avoid flush unless confirmed.

ben: Acknowledged. Restarting redis deployment:```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment redis-eu -n infra
# watching pods
kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=redis-eu -w
```

ben: Restart initiated. ETA for pod ready ~60s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: PD note added: "Redis restart in progress, traffic being scaled and fallback model enabled."

europe-oncall: Pod restarted, liveness back to green. Observed 5xx drop from ~18% -> ~4% in the last 3m. Continuing to watch for errors and queue backpressure.

support-jamie: Posting customer message on status page: "We are investigating intermittent embedding errors in EU region; mitigation underway. Next update in 30 minutes." :memo:

alex: Traces show error rate falling and latency stabilizing. No recent deploys to embeddings-api in last 2 hours, so this looks infra-related. I'll keep span traces open.

maya: Leaving a small automation to revert fallback model when 5xx < 1% for 30m. Command used:```bash
kubectl patch configmap embeddings-config -n prod -p '{"data":{"fallback_model":"v0.9-compact"}}'
```

ben: Taking ownership for stabilization and RCA. I'll run redis node diagnostics and check network metrics (ENI, SGs) during the incident window. Handoff noted — @europe-oncall, stay on standby for 15m then you can hand back. :white_check_mark:

europe-oncall: Copy — handing to @ben in 15. Marking incident as acknowledged and in-progress in PD. Customer impact: intermittent failures for ~14 customers, degraded performance for others. Recommend P1 for postmortem priority.

sre-lead: Please collect `kubectl describe` + `kubectl logs` for redis pods and attach to the PD incident. Also capture netflow and autoscaler logs for the timeframe.

ben: Will attach artifacts to PD-8472 and follow up with a timeline and RCA. Next status in 20m or on major change. TL;DR: redis flapping caused embeddings 5xx spike -> restart + scale + fallback model mitigated. :rocket:

incident-bot: PD-8472 updated: owner set to ben; status: monitoring.

alex: Adding note for post-incident: consider redis HA improvements and alert tuning to reduce customer impact.

support-jamie: Notifying affected customers with ETA and follow-up.

maya: I'll draft runbook updates while this is fresh.

ben: Taking over. End of active changes for now. Will update PD and close once 5xx < 1% for 30m and all checks pass. :handshake:
